desc: Runtime SCIP Indexing Service: runtime index refresh service, target-root language detection, enabled-language filtering against `config.scip_search`, fixed command mapping for `scip-go`, `scip-typescript`, and `scip-python`, output path construction under `.liza/scip`, task-worktree ignore setup, structured success/failure results, fakeable command runner seams, and read-only available-index discovery for prompt consumers. done_when: Tests prove the service indexes only languages that are both detected in the target root and enabled in `config.scip_search`, writes successful outputs under `<target>/.liza/scip/<language>.scip`, installs an idempotent worktree-local ignore rule so generated task indexes leave `git status --porcelain` clean, returns per-language failures without suppressing other languages, exposes only existing successful absolute index paths to prompt consumers, and can refresh two task worktrees concurrently without path collisions or shared output files.
